svg.title: Synkora Bot Worker Pool Architecture
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing consistent hash ring bot-to-worker assignment, Redis coordination, and dead worker failover with automatic bot migration.
svg.text: No central scheduler. Every worker independently derives its bot assignments from the same hash ring.

g.text: 51 bots · capacity 1,000 · heartbeat 4 s ago · Slack + Telegram + WhatsApp
47 bots · capacity 1,000 · heartbeat 7 s ago · Slack + Telegram
31 bots orphaned → W1 reclaims in ≤ 45 s
Heartbeat every 10 s. Dead threshold: 30 s. Dead-check loop: every 15 s. Worst-case bot downtime: 45 s.
On clean shutdown: worker self-unregisters — surviving workers detect in ≤ 15 s.
direct stop/restart once assignment is known via hash

svg.text: Built for the Synkora AI engineering journal
consistent hash · redis stream · heartbeat failover · no central scheduler
